description_en: This topic describes the syntax and provides examples of the gastric cancer detection feature (ScreenGC) in the image analysis and processing (imageprocess) category
description_zh: 本文介绍图像分析处理（imageprocess）类目下的胃癌检测ScreenGC的语法及示例
kebab_example: aliyun imageprocess screen-gc --data-format DICOM --org-name '测试组织' --org-id 7ff51bfe-e73d-11ea-827d-506b4b3f3cf6 --data-source-type HTTP_FILES --url-list URL=https://medclients-sh.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/demo/xxx/0001.dcm --region cn-hangzhou
name: ScreenGC

parameters.help_en: The image format. DICOM and NIFTI are supported
parameters.name: data_format

parameters.help_en: The name of the sub-channel (organization, such as a hospital) under the current channel (Alibaba Cloud account)
parameters.help_zh: 当前渠道（即主账号）下的子渠道（即机构，如医院）名称
parameters.name: org_name

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the sub-channel (organization, such as a hospital) under the current channel (Alibaba Cloud account)
parameters.help_zh: 当前渠道（即主账号）下的子渠道（即机构，如医院）标识
parameters.name: org_id

parameters.help_en: The type of input data. HTTP_FILES is supported
parameters.name: data_source_type

fields.help_en:
The URL list of DICOM series files or NIFTI files ["url","url",......]。
We recommend that you use Object Storage Service (OSS) links in the China (Shanghai) region. If the files are stored locally or in OSS in a region other than China (Shanghai), refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.

N in URLList.N.URL indicates the sequence number of the image URL in the current list (starting from 1). When you directly use the API, specify the URLList parameters in the format of URLList.1.URL=url1, URLList.2.URL=url2, and so on. Separate parameter pairs with ampersands (&). Replace url1, url2, and other values with actual values. When you use an SDK, use the corresponding methods provided by the SDK to populate the URLList
fields.help_zh:
DICOM序列文件URL列表或NIFTI文件URL列表["url","url",......]。
推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。

URLList.N.URL中的N为该图像URL在当前List中的顺序（从1开始）。当直接使用API请求时，输入URLList的填充会以URLList.1.URL=url1，URLList.2.URL=url2，......的方式指定参数和参数值，参数对以&连接，其中url1、url2、......等具体值请根据实际情况进行替换；当使用SDK填充URLList时，可直接使用SDK提供的相应的方法
fields.name: url

GCVolume.description_en: The gastric cancer lesion volume. Unit: cm³

Mask.description_en:
The lesion mask URL.

The URL is valid for 30 minutes. After 30 minutes, the URL expires and must be regenerated

有效时间为30分钟，30分钟后链接失效，需要重新生成

Probabilities.description_zh: 三类分类预测的概率，依次对应正常胃部、胃癌、非胃癌病变，取值范围0~1
